extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website’s subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A two-stage funnel annotation strategy combining LLM-based generation and human annotation for quality control.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering for legitimate queries and retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human annotators rewrite and calibrate the LLM-generated questions and answers to ensure correctness and consistency.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking LLMs in web traversal and evaluating RAG systems.

name.evidence: To address it, we introduce WebWalkerQA , a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal.

description.evidence: To address it, we introduce WebWalkerQA , a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website’s subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.

creator.evidence: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang(  ), Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang

inLanguage.evidence: WebWalkerQA is a bilingual dataset that includes both Chinese and English, reflecting the most widely used and universal languages in realworld web environments.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We employ a two-stage funnel annotation strategy, combining LLM-based and human annotation. In the first stage, GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2022b), performs initial annotations, followed by a second stage, where crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Traverse official websites recursively, collecting information on accessible sub-links and their respective pages... crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: WebWalkerQA encompasses four real-world domains: conference, organization, education, and game. These domains are selected because they provide authoritative information relevant to their respective fields, and their pages contain rich clickable content, offering substantial depth for exploration.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: After the synthetic queries are generated by LLM, human annotators can rewrite and calibrate the questions and answers to ensure the QA pairs are correct and consistent.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: In the first stage, GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2022b), performs initial annotations

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We evaluate the performance of the WebWalker, built on various mainstream LLMs, including both closed-source and open-sourced, using WebWalkerQA as the benchmark.
